<cite ref="Tosefta Bava Kamma 3:2">Tosef. B. Kam. III, 2</cite> if a man cut his neighbor’s plants, the latter has no right to say, <he>טול את הק׳ וכ׳</he> take thou the cut plants and restore to me the plants, but we assess the value &c.
